item.title: Top Republican warns Trump against making a deal with Iran: 'Finish the job'
item.description: Sen. Roger Wicker publicly warns Trump against pursuing a weak Iran deal, urging the president to continue military pressure on Tehran's regime.

item.title: Death toll from Israeli strikes on Lebanon passes 3,000, officials say
item.description: It marks a grim milestone in the conflict between Israel and the Lebanese armed group Hezbollah since March, despite a nominal ceasefire.

item.title: Hezbollah support endures in south Lebanon as ceasefire fails to stop war with Israel
item.description: Despite continuing Israeli attacks and occupation, many people in the south still believe the armed group is the only force capable of defending them.

item.title: Israel's Ben-Gvir sees 'no innocent people in Gaza or even Europe': Journalist Gideon Levy
item.description: FRANCE 24's François Picard welcomes veteran Israeli journalist and Haaretz columnist Gideon Levy. He offers a scathing analysis of Israeli politics, the Gaza war, the unprecedented rise of xenophobic nationalism and Israel's growing dependence on the United States. Speaking from Tel Aviv amid mounting electoral tensions, Levy argues that "everything – war and peace, domestic politics, legislation – is now covered by the shadow of the upcoming elections".

item.title: Early War Goal Was to Install Hard-Line Former President as Iran’s Leader
item.description: An Israeli strike designed to free Mahmoud Ahmadinejad from house arrest in Tehran, U.S. officials said, was part of an effort to bring about regime change and put him in power.

item.title: Iran warns it could open up 'new fronts' in war after US threatens ‘large-scale assault’
item.description: Washington and Tehran continued to trade threats Tuesday after US President Donald Trump said he could launch a fresh assault on Iran if a deal wasn't forthcoming in the next few days. The Islamic Republic in return warned it was prepared to open up "new fronts" in the event of a renewed US attack.

item.title: Israeli minister Smotrich says ICC prosecutor seeking warrant for his arrest
item.description: The Hague-based court declines to comment, saying applications for warrants are classified as secret.

item.title: Israeli forces board Gaza-bound flotilla near Cyprus, activists say
item.description: The Global Sumud Flotilla says commandos have intercepted more than 50 boats trying to breach the Gaza maritime blockade since Monday.

item.title: Fears of renewed Gaza war as Hamas disarmament talks stall
item.description: Israeli media reports suggest Israel is preparing to resume fighting because of the impasse in talks with Hamas.

item.title: Bowen: Strait of Hormuz standoff raises risk of sliding back into all-out war
item.description: The US and Iran's determination to keep the pressure on each other has put the fragile Gulf ceasefire in serious jeopardy.
